title: Lunch After Science
setting: A small cafe near the school with a long green table.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.look: Zoe, a girl with short black hair and round glasses

characters.name: Raj
characters.look: Raj, a boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt

sentences.en: After science class, Zoe and Raj feel hungry.
sentences.zh: 上完科学课，佐伊和拉吉饿了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a girl with short black hair and round glasses and Raj, a boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt walk out of a science room holding their tummies.

sentences.en: The special today is bread with meat and cheese.
sentences.zh: 今天的特色菜是夹肉和奶酪的面包。
sentences.scene_prompt: On a cafe counter sits a plate of bread with meat and cheese.

sentences.en: Raj pays for two plates at the counter.
sentences.zh: 拉吉在柜台付了两份的钱。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt hands coins to a smiling cook at the cafe counter while Zoe, a girl with short black hair and round glasses waits.

sentences.en: He carries them slowly to a long green table.
sentences.zh: 他慢慢地把它们端到一张长长的绿桌子旁。
sentences.scene_prompt: Raj, a boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt carefully carries two plates toward a long green table in the cafe.

sentences.en: An old policeman with white hair sits there.
sentences.zh: 一位白发的老警察坐在那里。
sentences.scene_prompt: At the long green table sits an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform, eating soup.

sentences.en: His glasses fall on the floor.
sentences.scene_prompt: A pair of glasses falls from the face of an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform onto the cafe floor.

sentences.en: Zoe picks them up for the kind man.
sentences.zh: 佐伊为这位和善的老人捡起眼镜。
sentences.scene_prompt: Zoe, a girl with short black hair and round glasses hands the glasses back to an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform.

sentences.en: “Thank you!” he calls, with a big smile.
sentences.zh: “谢谢你！”他大声说，笑得很开心。
sentences.scene_prompt: an old policeman with white hair, glasses and a blue uniform smiles widely and waves at Zoe, a girl with short black hair and round glasses and Raj, a boy with short brown hair and a blue shirt.
